g.text: A job is the work for one output bar/version. A stage is one step in that job. Some stages can overlap; others must wait for earlier steps.

text.style: font-size: 11px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #566171

g.text: Two modes: steer the model while it keeps playing, or take turns entering a flow and waiting for a model response.

g.text: Beat: the regular pulse. Bar: a group of beats.
Tick: a subdivision used for flow positions.

g.text: One bar: 16 ticks. At 90 BPM: beat = 0.667 s,
bar = 2.667 s, tick = 0.167 s. BPM = beats per minute.

g.text: Times are milliseconds (ms) unless marked seconds (s).
A timestamp says when; a duration says how long.
Subscripts identify which job, stage or version is meant.
